title: Domain Architect
description:
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* 12+ years of overall experience, with at least 6 years in an architect-level role.
* CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure, Data Center or Routing & Switching) or an equivalent expert-level certification. An active CCIE is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience as a senior technical authority on network and infrastructure solutions in enterprise environments.

**Technical Skills**

**Domain**

**Expectations**

**Routing & Switching**

Expert in BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, IS-IS, MPLS, multicast, QoS, VRF and segment routing; high availability and resiliency design

**Data Center**

Spine-leaf fabrics, VXLAN-EVPN, ACI/NSX or equivalent, multi-site/DCI, storage networking and automation; experience across multiple OEMs (e.g., Cisco, Arista, Juniper, HPE/Aruba, Dell, Nokia)

**Campus**

Hierarchical and fabric-based design, SD-Access or equivalent, segmentation, NAC (ISE/ClearPass), PoE and cabling considerations

**Wireless**

Enterprise Wi-Fi design (Wi-Fi 6/6E/7), predictive and validation surveys, controller and cloud architectures, location services, secure guest and IoT onboarding; end-to-end project delivery experience

**WAN / SD-WAN**

SD-WAN architecture, internet and MPLS underlay strategy, SASE integration, application-aware routing

**Cloud Connectivity**

Hybrid and multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP): Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, transit architectures, cloud-native networking

**Security Integration**

Zero Trust principles, firewall and segmentation design, network security alignment

**Automation & Operations**

Network automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform, APIs), telemetry, observability, NetDevOps familiarity

**Leadership Attributes**

* Excellent written and verbal communication; confident presenting to executives and customer leadership.
* Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Structured, vendor-neutral thinking with sound judgment on trade-offs, cost and risk.
* Ability to mentor, coach and raise the technical bar of the team.
* Ownership mindset, comfortable working in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.

Requirements:

**Title:** Domain Architect (Enterprise Networking & Infrastructure)

**Job Summary**  
The Domain Architect is the senior technical authority for network and infrastructure solutions. You will lead the design and oversight of large-scale transformation programs across data center, WAN, campus, wireless and cloud connectivity.  
The role combines deep hands-on technical credibility with architectural governance, customer-facing leadership and mentoring of engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

Architecture & Design

* Own end-to-end enterprise network architecture across Data Center, Campus, WAN/SD-WAN, Wireless and Cloud.
* Produce high-level and low-level designs (HLDs and LLDs), reference architectures and solution blueprints aligned to business and security requirements.
* Lead multi-OEM data center solutioning, including fabric design, overlay/underlay, automation and disaster recovery.
* Design wireless infrastructure covering RF planning, high-density environments, roaming, security and capacity.
* Evaluate technologies and OEMs, run proofs of concept and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions with clear trade-offs.

Transformation & Delivery Oversight

* Design and oversee large-scale network modernization and migration programs, including cutover strategy and risk mitigation.
* Act as the escalation point and design authority during implementation; review delivery quality against design intent.
* Support Services pre-sales where applicable: solution shaping, effort estimation, delivery planning and technical proposals.

Governance & Standards

* Define and maintain architectural governance frameworks, design standards and best practices.
* Establish documentation standards, including design documents, runbooks, as-built records and review checklists.
* Run design review boards and ensure compliance with security, resilience and operational standards.

Stakeholder Leadership

* Deliver clear presentations, roadmaps and executive-level briefings.
* Mentor engineers and senior consultants and build technical depth within the team.

title: Engineer: Design and Estimation
description:

To support project design, pre-sales and technical coordination, heat load calculations, BOQ preparation, cost estimation and tendering for commercial, pharmaceutical and industrial projects. The role works with clients, consultants, vendors and internal teams to develop technically sound and commercially competitive project proposals, while maintaining current knowledge of MEP engineering.

1. Project Design and Planning

* Design and support design activities for commercial, pharmaceutical and industrial projects.
* Perform heat load calculations to determine project requirements.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, specifications and project documentation.
* Coordinate with clients and consultants to understand project specifications and site conditions.

2. Pre-Sales and Customer Technical Support

* Conduct pre-sales site visits to assess project requirements, site conditions and potential challenges.
* Provide technical assistance to customers regarding product features, specifications and applications.
* Participate in technical sales meetings and address customer queries and concerns.

3. BOQ Preparation and Cost Estimation

* Prepare detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs) based on drawings and client requirements.
* Conduct quantity take-offs and estimate project costs, considering materials, labour and overheads.
* Review project scope changes and assess their impact on cost.
* Support accurate and timely preparation of estimates and commercial submissions.

4. Tendering and Sales/Marketing Support

* Participate in tendering activities and ensure estimates align with project specifications and tender requirements.
* Provide technical support for pre-bid, post-bid and negotiation meetings.
* Assist senior sales and marketing teams with technical inputs and, where required, identifying potential clients and supporting lead-generation activities.

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors, marketing, execution and purchase teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure effective communication, timely clarification of technical issues and completion of assigned tasks.
* Collaborate with team members and provide guidance or support to junior engineers where required.

6. Vendor Management and Negotiation

* Develop and maintain vendor relationships for technical and commercial matters.
* Discuss and negotiate technical and commercial terms with vendors to obtain competitive pricing and suitable project terms.
* Coordinate with vendors to clarify specifications and support procurement-related requirements.

7. Technical Expertise and Continuous Learning

* Stay updated on MEP engineering trends, technologies and relevant practices.
* Continuously enhance knowledge of project design, estimation, tendering and execution requirements.
* Apply problem-solving and project-management principles to improve work quality and delivery.

Qualifications and ExperienceEducational Qualifications

Experience

* Minimum 4–5 years of experience in project engineering, design and estimation, or relevant technical sales/pre-sales engineering roles.
* Experience in project design, cost estimation and tendering.

* Experience in vendor negotiation and client interaction is desirable.

Skills

* Strong analytical, technical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Project planning, organisation and prioritisation.
* Coordination, collaboration, negotiation and vendor-management skills.
* Ability to support team members and manage multiple tasks.

title: Presales Executive - AV/VC
description:
Job Profile -

We are seeking a highly skilled and versatile AV Pre-Sales Engineer to support the full lifecycle of audio-VIDEO CONFERENCING (AV) projects—from client consultations and solution proposals to system design and technical documentation. This role blends technical pre-sales support with hands-on AV design responsibilities, ensuring seamless transitions from concept to execution. You’ll work closely with clients, sales teams, engineers, and project managers to deliver innovative, high-performance AV solutions tailored to client needs and aligned with industry best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Consultation & Requirement Gathering:**

Collaborate with the sales team to understand client objectives, gather requirements, and offer expert AV recommendations. Conduct site surveys, feasibility studies, and client meetings to assess project scope and technical challenges. Translate client needs into detailed functional and technical specifications.

**Solution Design & Technical Proposals:**

Design customized AV solutions incorporating audio, video, control systems, and integration technologies. Develop system layouts, schematics, and equipment specifications using tools like AutoCAD, Visio, or Revit. Prepare compelling proposals, bill of materials (BOM), and cost estimates aligned with client budgets and expectations. Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, technically sound, and aligned with industry standards.

**Product Demonstrations & Technical Sales Support:**

Deliver live demos, technical presentations, and proof-of-concept trials to clients. Clearly explain AV system features, integration capabilities, and performance expectations. Support the sales process by addressing technical queries, assisting with RFPs/RFQs, and contributing to sales strategy.

**System Integration & Installation Support:**

Provide technical support during installation and commissioning to ensure designs are implemented correctly. Troubleshoot and calibrate AV systems in collaboration with on-site teams. Resolve design or integration issues quickly and effectively to maintain project timelines.

**Documentation & Reporting:**

Produce accurate and detailed design documents, schematics, as-built drawings, and user manuals. Maintain organized records of client interactions, project changes, and design iterations. Ensure seamless handovers to implementation teams through comprehensive documentation.

**Quality Control, Compliance & Standards:**

Validate that designs meet client requirements, safety regulations, and AV industry standards (e.g., AVIXA). Conduct design reviews and participate in quality assurance processes. Coordinate with IT, electrical, and architectural teams to ensure integration compatibility.

**Post-Sales & Ongoing Support:**

Provide technical support post-installation, addressing client concerns or system optimization needs. Suggest upgrades, modifications, or enhancements based on client feedback or evolving needs.

**Market Awareness & Innovation:**

Stay current with emerging AV technologies, integration methods, and design trends. Recommend new tools or products to improve project outcomes and customer satisfaction. Participate in training, certification programs, and industry events to maintain technical proficiency.

**Marketing & Thought Leadership:**

Contribute to whitepapers, brochures, case studies, and technical marketing content. Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and networking events as a technical subject matter expert.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

**Education:**

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Audio-Visual Technology, Systems Integration, or a related field.

**Experience:**

3–5 years in AV pre-sales, system design, integration, or related technical fields.

**Technical Tools:**

Proficiency in AV design and visualization tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, Revit, and D-tools.

**Systems Knowledge:**

Deep understanding of AV control platforms (e.g., Crestron, Q-SYS, AMX, Extron), Poly , Cisco , Logitech conferencing technologies, signal routing, and display/audio systems.

**Soft Skills:**

Strong interpersonal and communication abilities. Exceptional presentation and proposal-writing skills. Analytical thinking with strong attention to detail.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

Flexibility - occasional travel for site visits, client meetings, and system commissioning. Flexibility to work outside standard hours based on project or client needs. Split between office work, client engagement, and on-site support.

title: Manager, AI Services Consulting
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Manager, AI Services Consultant– Job Description**

  

**Why This Role? Why Now?**

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change; we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionising how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Manager role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimisation.

  

**Mission**

As the AI Services Manager at Zendesk, you will be leading a team by example with product expertise, and joining a management team in our expanding AI Delivery team.Your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure **seamless integration and optimisation of AI solutions** , driving transformative business outcomes.

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**

* Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realise measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale.
* Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
* Lead smooth, on-time delivery. Run projects end-to-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.
Build and lead the new AI Delivery team. Stand up the team, methodology and ways of working, while staying hands-on in customer delivery.  

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

**Strategic Accountabilities**

* **Technical Expertise & Guidance:** Provide expert advice on the **implementation and optimisation of Zendesk AI products,** ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
* **Change Management & Training:** Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and **integration of AI solutions** within customer organisations.
* **Successful Project Delivery:** Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, both your own and your team’s, owning delivery quality, capacity and utilization across the team, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams, including Customer Success and Sales, to ensure alignment on the customer’s AI Roadmap and address any technical challenges that would block the customer from adopting AI.
* **Tactical solutions for business outcomes:** Ensure that AI solutions are effectively aligned with customer business goals, resulting in measurable improvements in customer experience and AI Adoption.
* **Team Building & Leadership:** Build and lead the new AI Delivery team end to end, including hiring and onboarding, defining the delivery methodology and ways of working, assigning tasks and workloads, conducting performance evaluations, and creating individual growth plans to build a high-performing team.

  

**What You’ll Need to Succeed**

  

**Strategic Skills & Expertise**

* **Consulting Expertise:** Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Strong Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Project Management:** Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
* **Technical Proficiency in AI:** Deep understanding of AI technologies, particularly Zendesk AI products, with the ability to implement and optimise these solutions effectively.
* **Agility and Adaptability:** Ability to work effectively in diverse and dynamic environments, adapting to changing client needs and industry trends.
* **Problem-Solving Abilities:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify challenges and develop innovative solutions.
* **Continuous Learning:** Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting-edge solutions to clients.

  

**Qualifications**

* Must have a minimum of 8+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services.
* Previous experience in go-to-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS; either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre-sales consulting.
* **Strong hands-on experience working with API integration, specifically REST APIs, with a solid understanding of JSON and SQL scripting.**
* **End-to-end team handling experience, including conducting performance evaluations, creating growth plans, and assigning tasks.**
* Demonstrated experience in using adoption and health analytics to build predictive models and forecasts for churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommend mitigations to secure retention and growth.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
* Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Excellent program management and cross-functional influence skills.
* Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus.
Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders.  

  

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

title: Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking a Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant to help embed secure\-by\-design principles into supplier engagements from the earliest stages of the supplier lifecycle. This role focuses on identifying, assessing and mitigating cyber security and regulatory risks associated with third\-party suppliers, while ensuring compliance with UK Telecom Security Regulations and Vodafone’s internal security standards.
The successful candidate will work closely with business, technology and supplier stakeholders to evaluate supplier security postures, provide risk\-based security recommendations, influence sourcing decisions, and support the inclusion of appropriate contractual controls. This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting Vodafone’s supply chain while enabling secure and compliant business operations.**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Perform technical assessments of supplier security capabilities and regulatory compliance during supplier sourcing and contracting activities.
* Evaluate security and compliance risks using a standardised assessment methodology and identify effective mitigation measures.
* Provide security recommendations to support supplier selection and sourcing decisions.
* Engage with external suppliers to understand, validate and influence their security and regulatory compliance positions.
* Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and stakeholders to verify supplier security positions and support effective decision\-making.
* Act as the technical security specialist when communicating cyber security risks to business, technology and supplier stakeholders.
* Support supplier contract negotiations by identifying technical security requirements and recommending contractual controls to minimise risk.
* Develop, maintain and improve relevant processes, reporting and assessment tools.
* Provide guidance on cyber security and compliance\-related matters to internal colleagues and suppliers.
* Promote security as a business enabler and support the adoption of secure\-by\-design principles across supplier engagements.
* Ensure suppliers understand and adhere to Vodafone’s security standards and regulatory obligations.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experience working in a pre\-sales, sourcing, risk assessment or supplier security environment, evaluating responses and determining security recommendations.
* Strong ability to communicate security requirements, risks and mitigation measures to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, traffic flows, network architecture and security best practices.
* Experience managing and influencing stakeholders across different levels of an organisation.
* Significant professional experience in information technology and cyber security, ideally within supplier risk, security assurance or governance roles.
* Knowledge of cloud security, web services security, container security, connectivity, identity and access management, network security and penetration testing concepts.
* Understanding of security governance across Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environments.
* Expertise across telecommunications technologies including:
	+ Switching and routing technologies
	+ Routers, modems and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs)
	+ Radio Access Networks (RAN)
	+ Core routers, firewalls and border gateways
	+ Mobile devices, tablets and IoT environments
	+ Mobile Private Networks (MPN) using 4G/5G technologies
* University degree in Information Security or an equivalent discipline.
* One or more recognised industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, GIAC, TOGAF, SABSA or equivalent.
* 5\+ years of experience in cyber security.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to influence supplier security decisions across a global telecommunications environment.
* Exposure to complex cyber security, supplier assurance and regulatory compliance challenges.
* Collaboration with business, technology and cyber security specialists across multiple functions.
* Ability to contribute directly to Vodafone’s supply chain security strategy and risk reduction objectives.
* Experience working with evolving telecom security regulations and industry\-leading security practices.
* Opportunity to shape secure\-by\-design adoption across supplier ecosystems.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced supplier cyber security assessment and assurance techniques.
* Regulatory compliance evaluation, including UK Telecom Security requirements.
* Security risk quantification, recommendation development and risk mitigation planning.
* Contractual security control evaluation and negotiation support.
* Supplier governance and third\-party risk management practices.
* Stakeholder management and executive\-level security communication.
* Telecom network security across fixed, mobile and emerging technology environments.
* Security governance across cloud, SaaS, PaaS and IaaS delivery models.

----------------------------------------------

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
